sentences.en: The eggs I ate this morning both had two yolks.
sentences.zh: 今天早上我吃的两个鸡蛋都有双黄。

sentences.en: Separate the yolks from the whites without breaking the yolks.
sentences.zh: 将蛋黄和蛋白分开，但不要弄破蛋黄。

sentences.en: Break the eggs and separate the yolk from the whites.
sentences.zh: 把鸡蛋打破，然后分离出蛋黄和蛋白。

senses.zh: 蛋黄,卵黄,羊毛油脂,胚乳
